effects.text: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.
Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for any Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it.
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards you find there to your Benched Lightning Pokémon in any way you like.
Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

You can play this card only if 1 of your Pokémon was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.
Attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.
Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
You can play this card only if you discard another card from your hand. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand.
You can play this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
You can play this card only if you put another card from your hand in the Lost Zone. Choose a Pokémon Tool or Stadium in play and put it in the Lost Zone.
The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP.
If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon.
The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power 'Star Order': Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand.
Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box and put it onto their Bench. Then, shuffle their deck.
The Retreat Cost of each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is 1 Colorless less.
Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into their hand.
Once during each player's turn, that player may flip a coin. If heads, search their deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand.
Once during each player's turn, that player may attach a Basic Fire Energy card from their discard pile to 1 of their Benched Fire Pokémon. If they do, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
Look at the top card of your deck. You may put that card into your hand. If you don't, discard it and draw a card.
Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may reveal a Basic Pokémon card you find there and put it into your hand. If you do, replace it with this card and shuffle your Prize cards face down.
